1	# Java — detection
2	
3	Declares when the `java` profile activates on a given set of files. Consumed by `klaude-plugin/skills/_shared/profile-detection.md`. Multiple profiles may activate additively on the same diff.
4	
5	## Path signals
6	
7	_None._ Java detection does not use path heuristics; file extension alone is authoritative (see Content signals).
8	
9	## Filename signals
10	
11	_None._ Java detection is extension-based, not filename-based.
12	
13	## Content signals
14	
15	A file activates the Java profile if its extension is `.java`. The extension match is authoritative; no byte-level content inspection is required.
16
